title: Toots coined reggae & influenced early ska/rocakabiliy & shaped rock and roll then rock for decades. Direct line between sounds and styles of Maytals
summary: Toots coined reggae & influenced early ska/rocakabiliy & shaped rock and roll then rock for decades. Direct line between sounds and styles of Maytals and DJ Kool Herc (who thanks to his sister Cindy Campbell started hip hop)
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Toots coined reggae & influenced early ska/rocakabiliy & shaped rock and roll then rock for decades.

Direct line between sounds and styles of Maytals and DJ Kool Herc (who thanks to his sister Cindy Campbell started hip hop)
